patch.summary: GitHub Copilot cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: GitHub Copilot pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Copilot Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: GitHub Copilot cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price GitHub Copilot against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Copilot Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, reasoning / advanced models, writing and paraphrasing) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Not Microsoft 365 Copilot — no Word/Excel Graph assistant. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Teams already on GitHub who want IDE + PR Copilot requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
